name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Adds a way to stop sharing a specific piece of YOUR OWN content, two ways. (1) A new Catalog tab: browse your library by cover art, click to select one or more titles, then hide them from everyone, from one friend, or from just one of that friend's users - reuses the same per-friend/per-user exclude lists the People tab already had, just with a faster visual picker on top, plus a new global GloballyExcludedItemIds list for the "everyone" case. (2) A matching one-click "Stop sharing"/"Share again" action in the native "..." menu on the item's own detail page (only shown for your own items, never for federated ones - those were never yours to re-share), with an eye-with-a-line-through badge on the cover art while sharing is off, the same corner treatment the federated-item cloud badge already used. New backend: RemoteUserAccessRule.BlockedItemIds lets a per-user rule hide specific items even in 'All shared libraries' mode, enforced both server-side (authoritative) and on the receiving side (defense in depth), same dual-check pattern as the existing Mode/rating fields. 223 tests, all still green.
